description: This file defines the FastAPI API router for managing notes within a secure notes application. It includes endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching notes, with appropriate request/response schemas. It also contains internal helper functions for transforming note data into response objects.

methods.name: NoteResponse _to_note_response(note)
methods.description: Transforms a Note object into a NoteResponse, including note details and sorted tags.

methods.name: NoteResponse create_note_endpoint( payload: NoteCreateRequest, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)], )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new note for the authenticated user.

methods.name: NoteListResponse list_notes_endpoint( current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)], offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Pagination offset."), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Pagination limit."), tag: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by tag name."), archived: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="If true list archived only; if false list unarchived only."), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list notes belonging to the authenticated user, with optional filtering by tag and archive status.

methods.name: NoteResponse get_note_endpoint( note_id: uuid.UUID, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)], )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific note by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: NoteResponse update_note_endpoint( note_id: uuid.UUID, payload: NoteUpdateRequest, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)], )
methods.description: API endpoint to update an existing note's content and tags.

methods.name: None delete_note_endpoint( note_id: uuid.UUID, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)], )
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a note by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: SearchResponse search_notes_endpoint( q: str = Query(..., min_length=1, description="Search query string."), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Pagination offset."), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200, description="Pagination limit."), current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)] = None, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_db_session)] = None, )
methods.description: API endpoint to perform a full-text and fuzzy search on notes for the authenticated user.
